# GetMeds hub: complete feature inventory

*12 November 2026. Every feature of the GetMeds hub (hub.getmeds.ph, the order-process tool the CRM
replaces), read from its source, with what the CRM lacks at the end. Read only: nothing in the hub was
run. No sales figures and no personal data; demo account names only.*

**Source.** `github.com/manila404/getmeds-system`, commit `15e4ad3` (12 Nov 2026 09:07 Manila),
cloned read-only. `getmeds-backend` is a Node / Express API on Supabase Postgres (it began on SQLite);
`getmeds-frontend` is a React / Vite single-page app. About 60,000 lines of code outside the lock
files, plus 139 test files.

**How it was read.** The code was cut into eleven slices and each slice was read line by line, not
sampled (the slice letter is in every subheading, e.g. "[A]"):

| Slice | What | Main files |
|---|---|---|
| A | Orders backend | `orders.controller.js` (4,953 lines), the state machine, the 17 order services, search |
| B | Order entry and the frontend's plumbing | `OrderForm.jsx` (3,237 lines), the items editor, New Customer, the MedRep pages, constants, hooks, API, context, router |
| C | Order page, its dialogs and management's queues | `OrderDetailPage.jsx` (2,436 lines), 21 order dialogs, UI parts, Approval Queue, Exception Hub, Refund requests |
| D | Finance verification, payment proofs, attachments, refunds | finance, paymentProof, refunds and refundRequests controllers and services, Finance pages and components |
| E | Dispatch, pharmacy, inventory, stock announcements | dispatch, pharmacy, inventory and stockAnnouncements controllers, dispatch pages and components, Inventory page |
| F1 | Customers | customers controllers, customer create / details / TIN / Zoho update services, Clients and Pending Customers pages |
| F2 | Users, roles, sales structure, scopes, app frame | admin, auth, structure, sales-move, mapping, scope controllers and services, Users page, Sidebar, Topbar, Login, Profile |
| G | KPIs, scorecard, targets, dashboards, reports | kpi, management and admin-overview controllers, KPI and scorecard services, Zoho invoice copy, dashboards |
| H1 | Zoho adapter and the write path to Zoho | `LiveZohoAdapter.js` (1,398 lines), payload builder, line sync, edit diff, retry outbox, write lock, status map |
| H2 | Webhooks, Zoho import and reconcile, jobs, notifications, audit, Discord, deployment, scripts | `webhook.controller.js`, `zohoOrderImportService.js`, reconcile, cron, notification and audit services, every maintenance script |
| I | Data model and test mode | `schema.pg.sql`, `migrate.pg.js`, the database layer, test mode |

**Short source names.** `OC` = `getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js` (used by slice A). Other paths are relative to the hub repo root.

**How to read the tables.** Sections 1 to 18 follow the areas asked for; inside each, every slice that
touches the area adds its own subsections. Each row is one feature, field group, action, endpoint or
rule: *how it works in the hub* (fields, rules, statuses, who may, who is told) and *source* (path in
the hub repo with line numbers). Section 19 lists every role's screens and actions, section 20 keeps
each slice's notes and counts, and section 21 is what the CRM does not have yet, or has only in part.

## The hub in numbers

| What | Count | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Screens (routes) | 36 routes, 31 page components | 2 of the routes are redirects (`/signup`, `/management/manager-scopes`); 3 are behind build switches (`/admin/kpi-scorecard/:tab`, `/admin/overview-mock`, and the KPI pages behind `GETMEDS_KPI_PAGE`); Finance's page has 3 views (`?view=mine`, `?view=reports`, `?stage=`) |
| Dialogs and panels | about 70 | order form sections, the 21 order dialogs, finance drawer and confirm, dispatch holds and slips, customer review dialogs, user and structure editors, KPI tabs |
| API endpoints | 210 | 208 route lines in 23 route files plus `/api/health` and `/api/products`; 126 change data (99 POST, 16 PATCH, 8 DELETE, 3 PUT), 4 are scheduler endpoints, the rest are reads. Includes 3 legacy aliases and the webhook's alias |
| User actions on screens | about 190 | buttons that change data, counted per slice (200 with overlaps between the backend and screen slices removed) |
| Database tables | 35 | plus order-event partitions, 5 functions, 4 triggers, the trigram extension, the per-day order number counter; files in a Supabase bucket and a Sanity dataset |
| Order statuses | 18 | `draft`, `pending_management_approval`, `submitted`, `validating`, `so_pending`, `so_created`, `ready_for_finance_verified`, `ready_for_draft_invoice`, `ready_for_invoice_sent`, `ready_for_dispatch`, `picking_packing`, `dispatched`, `tracking_shared`, `on_hold`, `exception`, `completed`, `cancelled`, `deleted` (retired names such as `waiting_for_payment`, `invoice_drafted`, `invoice_sent`, `payment_verified` were remapped) |
| Notification types | about 30 | each in-app, emailed to the order's MedRep when SMTP is set, and posted to Google Chat when its webhook is set; Discord thread per order when switched on |
| KPIs and reports | about 80 | about 40 KPI figures and scorecard measures (slice G), and about 40 other reports, tiles and counts (finance, dispatch, pharmacy, customers, structure, sync health) |
| Zoho calls | 26 | Zoho Inventory v1 (sales orders, invoices, credit notes, packages, shipments, contacts, items, batches, warehouses, salespersons, attachments) and Books v3 for one backfill script |
| Scheduled jobs | 8 | GitHub Actions every 15 minutes (reconcile / auto-sync), nightly backup, Vercel daily crons, a 15-minute Supabase `pg_cron` invoice copy, in-process loops, notification retention, Zoho retry, a Windows nightly enrichment task |
| Roles | 6 | `medrep`, `team_lead`, `management` (full or limited to chosen divisions), `finance`, `dispatch` (shown as "Operation": dispatch and pharmacy), `admin`; test mode lets an admin act as any role |

## The order's road in one paragraph

A MedRep, team lead, manager or admin raises an order (`GM-YYYYMMDD-NNNN`) for a customer, choosing who
it is for, the invoicing company (2mg Incorporated or Getmeds Philippines Inc., per order and per line),
Zoho salesperson, division / sub-division / headquarter, source, payment terms, tax inclusive or
exclusive, delivery details, lines (warehouse, tax, discount, price remark) and files (proof of payment,
prescription, PO), with a reason when proof or prescription is missing. Orders from MedReps and team
leads, and every B2B order, wait in Management's Approval Queue (approve with a per-warehouse stock check,
reject, send back, hold for stock); approval creates the Zoho Sales Order (split into two when lines are
invoiced from both companies). Operation's pharmacist verifies the prescription in parallel; Finance
verifies the account and payment (per company half, with holds carrying screenshots). Then invoice
drafted and sent, picking and packing, dispatched, tracking shared, delivered; the order completes when it
is shipped and paid. Holds, exceptions, cancellations (with refund owed), refund requests with a goods
return check, and Zoho webhooks / reconcile keep the order in step with Zoho throughout.

## 1. Orders and their stages

### [A] Status map (workflow/stateMachine.js)

| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Statuses (18) | draft, pending_management_approval, submitted, validating, so_pending, so_created, ready_for_finance_verified, ready_for_draft_invoice, ready_for_invoice_sent, ready_for_dispatch, picking_packing, dispatched, tracking_shared, on_hold, exception, completed, cancelled, deleted. (`payment_verified`, `invoice_drafted`, `invoice_sent`, `waiting_for_payment` are retired names.) | getmeds-backend/src/workflow/stateMachine.js:10-46, 47-133 |
| draft -> | submitted, pending_management_approval, ready_for_finance_verified, ready_for_draft_invoice, cancelled, deleted | getmeds-backend/src/workflow/stateMachine.js:64 |
| pending_management_approval -> | submitted, draft (send back), ready_for_finance_verified, ready_for_draft_invoice, on_hold (reject), cancelled, deleted | getmeds-backend/src/workflow/stateMachine.js:72 |
| submitted -> / validating -> / so_pending -> | submitted: validating, exception, deleted; validating: so_pending, exception, deleted; so_pending: so_created, exception, deleted (bookkeeping hops logged during the Zoho push) | getmeds-backend/src/workflow/stateMachine.js:73-75 |
| so_created -> | ready_for_finance_verified, on_hold, cancelled, deleted | getmeds-backend/src/workflow/stateMachine.js:79 |
| ready_for_finance_verified -> | ready_for_draft_invoice, ready_for_invoice_sent, ready_for_dispatch, picking_packing, dispatched (an invoice raised straight in Zoho is accepted as proof Finance approved), on_hold, cancelled, deleted | getmeds-backend/src/workflow/stateMachine.js:81-94 |
| ready_for_draft_invoice -> / ready_for_invoice_sent -> | ready_for_draft_invoice: ready_for_invoice_sent, ready_for_dispatch, picking_packing, dispatched, on_hold, cancelled, deleted; ready_for_invoice_sent: ready_for_dispatch, picking_packing, dispatched, on_hold, cancelled, deleted (invoice-first and dispatch-first both allowed) | getmeds-backend/src/workflow/stateMachine.js:96-105 |
| ready_for_dispatch -> | picking_packing, dispatched, completed, on_hold, cancelled, deleted ("invoice issued, go pack") | getmeds-backend/src/workflow/stateMachine.js:107-108 |
| picking_packing -> / dispatched -> / tracking_shared -> | picking_packing: dispatched, ready_for_invoice_sent, ready_for_dispatch, completed, on_hold, cancelled, deleted; dispatched: tracking_shared, completed, ready_for_invoice_sent, ready_for_dispatch, exception, deleted; tracking_shared: completed, ready_for_invoice_sent, ready_for_dispatch, exception (lost parcel, disputed delivery), deleted | getmeds-backend/src/workflow/stateMachine.js:110-123 |
| on_hold -> / exception -> | on_hold: ready_for_finance_verified, ready_for_draft_invoice, ready_for_invoice_sent, ready_for_dispatch, picking_packing, cancelled, exception, deleted; exception: on_hold, cancelled, deleted | getmeds-backend/src/workflow/stateMachine.js:125-129 |
| Terminal | completed, cancelled, deleted: no further moves; 'deleted' reachable from every non-terminal state (SO removed in Zoho) | getmeds-backend/src/workflow/stateMachine.js:130-137 |
| Status write service | `setOrderStatus(id, from, to)`: no-op if same; refuses (logs warning, returns refused:true, never throws) from a terminal or a hop the map forbids; else `UPDATE orders SET status, updated_at`. `advanceTo` = move only if allowed, else skip quietly. Used by Zoho-driven paths and most actions. | getmeds-backend/src/services/orderStatusService.js:26-63 |
| Writes that bypass the map | `resume` and `resubmit` (non-finance branch) and `setException` write status directly (resume/resubmit to any of RESUMABLE_TO; setException checks the map first) | OC:4569-4594, 4629-4673, 4020-4031 |

| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Order id format | `<prefix>-YYYYMMDD-NNNN` (UTC date, 4-digit day sequence): `GM-` normally, `TestGM-` while ZOHO_TEST_CUSTOMER_ID is set, `DryGM-` while ZOHO_DRY_RUN; sent to Zoho as the Sales Order reference_number | getmeds-backend/src/services/orderIdService.js:1-17, 79-87 |

| Imported orders | `ZOHO-` prefix = imported from Zoho (60,817 historical SOs); origin filter getmeds / zoho / all, default getmeds; unknown prefix counts as created here | getmeds-backend/src/services/orderOrigin.js:1-83 |

### [H1] Order → Zoho Sales Order: when it is created

| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| The only order-level write path | Controllers call `require('../integrations/zoho')` (a facade); `zoho.createSalesOrder(orderData)` creates the Sales Order (SO). It always lands as **Draft** (no confirm call follows). Never looks up or creates a contact or item; both ids must already be known. | getmeds-backend/src/integrations/zoho/ZohoAdapter.js:131-148; getmeds-backend/src/integrations/zoho/LiveZohoAdapter.js:245-293 |
| Created at order create | `POST /api/orders` (roles medrep, management, admin, team_lead): the SO is created **before** the DB transaction, only when the order is not a draft, does not require Management approval, and its customer is not held (`customers.zoho_sync_status='pending'`). Held customer → order `zoho_sync_status='pending'`, error text "Customer is not in Zoho yet — this order will sync once the customer does." | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:2700-2741 |
| Created at Management approval | `POST /api/orders/:id/approve` (management, admin) logs `MANAGEMENT_APPROVED` ("Approved by Management — syncing to Zoho." + warehouse note) then `syncOrderToZohoAndFinalize`. A MedRep's submit stops at `pending_management_approval` and creates nothing in Zoho. | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:3730-3760; getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:3585-3615 |
| Created at Management/admin direct submit | `POST /api/orders/:id/submit` by management/admin (not a MedRep) generates the order id and runs `syncOrderToZohoAndFinalize` straight away. | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:3617-3640 |
| Never a second SO on re-approval | If `orders.zoho_so_id` is already set (approved, then held / sent back, then approved again) the existing SO is reused, sync status `synced`, nothing created; log note "Approved again — its existing Zoho Sales Order SO-… was kept (no new one created)". | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:3270-3296 |
| TIN pushed before the SO | If the order carries `intake_tin`, `setCustomerTin` writes it to the Zoho contact (`cf_tin`) first, because Zoho refuses an SO for a "business" contact with no TIN ("Please Add Customer TIN"). Soft: a failure only logs a warning. Same step in create, approve/submit and every retry. | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:2565-2585; getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:3187-3197; getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoRetryService.js:153-163 |
| Status hops when the SO exists | Order logged through `submitted → validating → so_pending → so_created`, then stored as `ready_for_finance_verified` for every order (credit or direct). Direct: a `payments` row (status pending) is inserted; credit: a `dispatch_records` row (status queued); both `ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO NOTHING`. `orders.zoho_so_status` seeded `draft`. | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:3313-3398 |
| SO create failure never blocks the order | Failure → order still created/submitted with `zoho_sync_status='failed'`; a `zoho_sync_queue` row is enqueued in the same transaction; the `so_created` hop note reads "Zoho sync failed, queued for automatic retry: <error>". | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:3297-3311; getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:3343-3345 |
| Notifications after the SO is created | Order's MedRep: "Your order <id> for <customer> has been submitted (Sales Order drafted in Zoho — awaiting confirmation \| Waiting for Finance Payment Verification)." Direct order: all finance users "New direct patient order <id> requires payment verification." Credit order: all dispatch users "New credit order <id> drafted in Zoho — will reach dispatch once Finance confirms the Sales Order." | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:3415-3436 |
| Attachments caught up when the SO first exists | Right after a new SO, `pushUnsyncedAttachments(orderId, soId)` pushes every local attachment not yet pushed (proofs attached as a draft, etc.). | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:3455-3466; getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoAttachmentSync.js:39-91 |
| Split order gets a second SO | If any line is set to the other `invoicing_from` entity, a second SO is created for those lines after the order row exists (not again when the primary SO was reused). | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:3443-3453; getmeds-backend/src/services/orderSplitService.js:139-205 |
| SO date | `date` = `new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)` — the **UTC** date (an SO raised before 08:00 Manila is dated the previous day). Not touched on an edit. | getmeds-backend/src/integrations/zoho/LiveZohoAdapter.js:266-268; getmeds-backend/src/integrations/zoho/LiveZohoAdapter.js:305-313 |
| Customer-is-a-vendor error rewritten | Zoho's "selected a contact of the correct contact type (customer/vendor)" is prefixed: "The customer on this order is a vendor in Zoho, and Zoho only accepts Sales Orders for customers. Management can use \"Fix customer link\" on the order. Zoho said: …". | getmeds-backend/src/integrations/zoho/LiveZohoAdapter.js:270-284 |
| Customer withholding-tax (TDS) flag after every SO | After a successful create, `PUT /contacts/{customer_id}` `{ is_tds_registered: true }` once per contact per server process (in-memory `tdsEnsured` set), best-effort; failure only logged. Purpose: Zoho shows "Tax deducted?" on a payment only for TDS-registered customers. | getmeds-backend/src/integrations/zoho/LiveZohoAdapter.js:14-16; getmeds-backend/src/integrations/zoho/LiveZohoAdapter.js:285-303 |

| Identifier and order lookup | identifier = salesorder_id (from salesorder / invoice / payment / shipment / package object) \|\| reference_number \|\| salesorder_number \|\| body.order_id \|\| body.getmeds_order_id \|\| body.reference_number. findOrder matches `orders.zoho_so_id = ? OR getmeds_order_id = ? OR zoho_so_number = ?` (joins customer name/type and the MedRep's id, name, email); only if that misses, `order_split_sales_orders.zoho_so_id / zoho_so_number` (then `_splitMatch` routes to the split handler). No identifier → 200 `processed:false` "No sales order or reference identifier found"; no order → 200 `processed:false` "order is not present in local database" (never an error, so Zoho does not retry) | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/webhook.controller.js:116-155, 265-291 |
| Precedence of categories | Payment (rawEvent contains `payment` or `invoice.paid`, invoice status `paid`, or payment status `success` / amount > 0) > Invoice Sent (event `invoice.sent`, `ready_for_dispatch`, `invoice.mark_sent`, `invoice.marked_sent`, or invoice status `sent` when the event is not a creation) > Invoice Drafted (`invoice.created`, `invoice.drafted`, `invoice_created`, or invoice status draft/open) > SO Confirmed (`salesorder.confirmed`/`salesorder_confirmed` or SO status in confirmed, open, partially_shipped, shipped, fulfilled, partially_fulfilled, closed, invoiced, partially_invoiced) > Cancel/Delete (`salesorder.deleted`; `salesorder.void`, `salesorder.cancelled`, status void/cancelled/voided) > Shipment (shipment object, `shipment.created`, `shipment_created`, `shipment.dispatched`, `shipmentorder`, any `shipment` not `package`, `fulfilled`, SO status fulfilled/shipped) > Package (package object, `package.created`, `package_created`, any `package` not `shipment`) > `salesorder.edited` (exact literal only) > anything else logged | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/webhook.controller.js:326-419, 490-1233 |
| Duplicate / echo suppression | For invoice sent/drafted, SO confirmed, shipment and package (never payment, void, delete or edit): skipped as `ALREADY_RECORDED` when order_events already holds the same kind with the same Zoho id in metadata (`zohoInvoiceId`; `zohoSoId` or `zohoSalesOrderId`; `zohoShipmentId` and the same tracking number as dispatch_records; `zohoPackageId`), or `DEFERRED_TO_GETMEDS_ACTION` when the order holds a fresh `action_claim` (within orderClaimService.CLAIM_TTL_MS, i.e. someone is pressing the Workflow V2 button that records it) | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/webhook.controller.js:421-488 |
| Response | 200 `{ success, processed:true, action, order_id (GM id), previous_status, new_status }`. Notifies MedRep + finance + dispatch: "Invoice {INV#} for {GM} has been sent to the customer." (INVOICE_SENT) | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/webhook.controller.js:573-631 |

Event ZOHO_PACKAGE_CREATED "Package created in Zoho — items picked & packed, awaiting shipment" (metadata zohoPackageId, zohoPackageNumber). ### [H2] Split-invoicing orders (an order's second Sales Order)

| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Webhook for a split's own Sales Order | Writes only to `order_split_sales_orders` (never orders.status; completion combines splits). Clears a split's `zoho_sync_status='failed'` → 'synced' (and zoho_sync_error) once Zoho shows it confirmed/invoiced/packed/shipped/paid. Payment → zoho_paid_status='paid' (ZOHO_PAYMENT_VERIFIED); invoice sent → zoho_invoiced_status='sent' + invoice id/number; drafted → 'draft'; deleted → zoho_so_status='deleted'; void → 'cancelled'; confirmed → 'confirmed'; shipment → zoho_shipped_status='shipped' + shipment id/number; package → package id/number. Each logged on the order's trail as "[{entity}] …" with metadata invoicingFrom, splitId. No echo de-duplication (idempotent writes); no notifications | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/webhook.controller.js:157-250, 293-306 |
| Split reconcile (manual sync, poller, page open) | For each split row with a zoho_so_id and not deleted (orders not ZOHO- imported): getSalesOrder; 404 / Zoho code 5 / "does not exist" → zoho_so_status='deleted' + ZOHO_SO_DELETED; else deriveSplitState: soStatus cancelled/draft/confirmed, latest non-void invoice (draft vs sent, paid if paid/closed), latest package, shipped (package shipment_status/status shipped/delivered/fulfilled or SO shipped_status shipped/partially_shipped/fulfilled), shipment ids. Writes and logs only what changed (ZOHO_SO_CONFIRMED, ZOHO_SO_CANCELLED, ZOHO_INVOICE_DRAFTED/SENT, ZOHO_PAYMENT_VERIFIED, ZOHO_PACKAGE_CREATED, ZOHO_DISPATCHED, "[entity]" prefix); then line items and total synced for that entity's lines only. Returns { splits:[{invoicing_from, zoho_so_number, changes, items, error}], changed }. Never throws | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoSplitReconcileService.js:1-198 |

### [H2] Order completion (shipped AND paid), as called from the webhook and reconcile

| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Completion rule | An order completes when it is shipped AND paid, in either order: the payment branch and the shipment branch both call evaluateCompletion. Paid = a `payments` row with status verified (or, for ZOHO- imported orders only, Zoho's own paid axis / Zoho "done"); a split order needs every split's payment_status verified. → status `completed`, event ORDER_COMPLETED ("shipped and paid … closed out by the {payment\|shipment} event"), dated by the caller (the later of invoice and ship dates when backfilled). Refused by the state machine → ORDER_COMPLETION_BLOCKED. Notifies MedRep + every finance user "Order {GM} is complete — shipped and paid." (management dropped Sep 23 to cut notification volume) | getmeds-backend/src/services/orderCompletionService.js:55-92, 200-272; getmeds-backend/src/controllers/webhook.controller.js:559-567, 855-867 |
| Payment moves no stage | A payment webhook records money and may complete the order but never moves the pipeline (customers are on terms; payment usually lands last) | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/webhook.controller.js:512-535 |

### [H2] Zoho reconcile: catching up what a webhook missed

| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Three callers, one implementation | POST /api/orders/:id/sync-from-zoho (the "Sync from Zoho" button), GET /api/orders/:id (refresh on open, throttled), the auto-sync poller; plus the bulk import. Never throws: returns { ok, action, zohoStatus, order, events } or { ok:false, code NOT_FOUND \| NO_ZOHO_SO ("This order does not have a Zoho Sales Order yet.") \| ZOHO_FETCH_FAILED \| RECONCILE_FAILED, message }. Trail actor is "Zoho"; the person who triggered it goes to metadata syncedBy / syncedAt / source (manual_reconcile, page_open, auto_sync, zoho_import) | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoReconcileService.js:39-112, 803-809 |
| Sales Order deleted in Zoho (detected on read) | getSalesOrder fails with HTTP 404, Zoho code 5 or "does not exist" → ZOHO_SO_DELETED; status `deleted` unless completed/cancelled/deleted; refusal written in the note; re-runs until the status reflects it. Notifies MedRep + admin + management (ORDER_DELETED_IN_ZOHO). Other read failures → ZOHO_FETCH_FAILED "Could not reach Zoho: …" | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoReconcileService.js:127-236 |
| Edits made in Zoho (backfill) | Same 7-field diff as the webhook on every reconcile (not gated by "already logged"); writes columns; ZOHO_SO_EDITED dated by Zoho's last_modified_time; notifies MedRep + finance; Paid-terms-early alert. Then line items and total synced (action ITEMS_SYNCED when that is all) | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoReconcileService.js:261-333 |
| One checkpoint per pass, in pipeline order | If SO past draft (CONFIRMED_OR_BEYOND list) and no ZOHO_SO_CONFIRMED yet → confirm (as webhook; dated by SO created_time; notifies MedRep). Else if void/cancelled and not logged and order not finished → `cancelled` (ZOHO_SO_CANCELLED dated last_modified_time; notifies MedRep + admin + management). Else invoice → package → shipment, chronological, one per pass | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoReconcileService.js:34-37, 238-256, 335-416, 472-486 |
| Invoice backfill | Latest invoice on the SO. Needs backfill when its id differs from orders.zoho_invoice_id or a paid/sent stage is not yet logged, and the order is not cancelled/completed. Paid/closed or sent/overdue/partially_paid → `ready_for_dispatch` + ZOHO_INVOICE_SENT; else → `ready_for_invoice_sent` + ZOHO_INVOICE_DRAFTED (from so_created, ready_for_finance_verified, ready_for_draft_invoice, tracking_shared, ready_for_invoice_sent). Dated by the invoice date (never before SO creation, occurred_at_exact=false). Paid → payments row upserted verified (reference = invoice number, amount = invoice total, note "Verified from Zoho invoice status by manual sync") + ZOHO_PAYMENT_VERIFIED + completion check. Notifies MedRep + finance (INVOICE_SENT or INVOICE_DRAFTED) | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoReconcileService.js:449-632 |
| Package backfill | When the SO has packages and no ZOHO_PACKAGE_CREATED yet: dispatch_records set/inserted 'packing'; order advanced to picking_packing only from the four pre-packing statuses; dated by the package date; notifies MedRep (DISPATCH_STATUS_UPDATE "Package found in Zoho") | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoReconcileService.js:633-686 |
| Shipment backfill | Shipped = latest package shipment_status/status in shipped/delivered/fulfilled, or SO shipped_status shipped/partially_shipped/fulfilled (tracking number optional: "no tracking number recorded" is normal for in-house and Lalamove). dispatch_records → dispatched; order → dispatched → tracking_shared (TRACKING_ENTERED); completion dated at the later of invoice and ship; ZOHO_DISPATCHED; notifies MedRep (ORDER_DISPATCHED) | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoReconcileService.js:422-447, 687-796 |
| Reconcile until done | reconcileOrderFully repeats reconcileOrder up to 7 passes until NOTHING_NEW (warns if all 7 did work), then reconciles split Sales Orders; returns the last real action, the list of actions and passes. One fetched SO may be reused across passes (bulk import) | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoReconcileService.js:811-873 |
| Manual "Sync from Zoho" endpoint (uses this service) | POST /api/orders/:id/sync-from-zoho (signed in): 404 if missing; a MedRep only on their own (medrep_id or raised_by_id), Team Lead only on their own, other roles any. Runs reconcileOrder (one pass), split reconcile, then mirrors Zoho's Comments & History (ingestSalesOrderLogs). Errors: 404 NOT_FOUND, 400 NO_ZOHO_SO, 502 otherwise. Returns action, zoho_status, order, events, splits, zoho_log_entries_added | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:1005-1086; getmeds-backend/src/routes/orders.routes.js:108-111 |
| Refresh when an order is opened | GET /api/orders/:id runs reconcileOrderFully (source page_open, actor "{name} (opened the order)") when shouldRefreshOnOpen: has a Zoho SO, not completed/cancelled/deleted, last_reconciled_at older than 60 s (ZOHO_AUTO_SYNC_OPEN_COOLDOWN_MS). Waits at most ZOHO_OPEN_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_MS (4000 ms) then serves the order as it is; stamps last_reconciled_at when done; any failure is swallowed (showing the order is the contract) | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:279, 830-878; getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoAutoSyncService.js:111-139 |

Please upload a replacement." | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/pharmacy.controller.js:353-357, 377-417, 536 |
| Re-review | `POST .../re-review` {action: verify / reject / reset / undo, reason}: dispatch/admin only; reviewable; verify/reject/reset act on the live (not superseded) rejected files, undo on live verified files (404 "no open rejection to re-review" / "no verified prescription to undo"). verify -> verified (stamped) and pushed to Zoho; reject -> stays rejected with a new reason (≤500, required); reset and undo -> pending with who/when cleared. Event RX_RE_REVIEWED with action (undo notes the copy already on Zoho: "remove it in Zoho if it should not be kept"). Notifies MedRep + raiser on reject ("still rejected by Pharmacy — updated reason: …") and reset ("Pharmacy is taking another look"); nothing on verify/undo | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/pharmacy.controller.js:538-666 |
| No-Rx decision | `POST .../no-rx-decision` {action: request / not_required, reason}: dispatch/admin; NOT gated on reviewable (any status except deleted); refused if any Rx row exists (409 HAS_PRESCRIPTION). not_required: sets rx_not_required_by/at/reason (reason optional ≤500), event RX_NOT_REQUIRED, no notification. request: reason required, clears any not-required call, event RX_REQUESTED, notifies MedRep + raiser "Order X: Pharmacy needs a prescription — {reason}. Please upload one." Latest call wins | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/pharmacy.controller.js:668-764 |
| MedRep resubmits | `POST /api/orders/:id/resubmit-prescription` {note required ≤500, e.g. "Replacement uploaded" / "Quantity is on page 2"}: admin, management, the order's MedRep or raiser, a team lead for own/team order; blockMedrepWritesOnImported; reviewable; only if rejected, pending after an earlier rejection, or requested (409 NOTHING_TO_RESUBMIT). Live rejected files reset to pending; event RX_RESUBMITTED with the note; notifies every dispatch user (except the actor) "Order X: the prescription was re-submitted by NAME for your review. {note}". Finance untouched | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/pharmacy.controller.js:443-533 ; getmeds-backend/src/routes/orders.routes.js:101 |

### [F1] Customer record (what the hub keeps per customer)
| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Identity and naming | `name` (Zoho contact_name / display name; NOT NULL), `contact_person` (Zoho first + last name), `contact_number` (Zoho phone else mobile; on create = typed phone), `email`, `address` (one free-text line; "See Zoho" placeholder when blank). | getmeds-backend/src/db/schema.pg.sql:155-219 |
| Payment type `type` | `credit` or `direct` (CHECK). Inferred on first sync from Zoho `customer_sub_type` (business → credit, else direct); never re-derived on later syncs so a local correction sticks; customers created in the hub are always `direct` ("no agreed credit limit yet"). No endpoint or screen in the hub changes it. | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:294-299,386,454-462; getmeds-backend/src/services/customerCreateService.js:820-832 |
| Category `category` | Local only, never sent to Zoho: `doctor`, `hospital`, `distributor`, `pwd`, `patient` or NULL (uncategorised). Kept separate from `type`. Create flow allows only doctor/hospital/distributor/patient (PWD removed 29 Sep: "a discount programme, not a customer class"). | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:11-14; getmeds-backend/src/services/customerCreateService.js:63; getmeds-backend/src/db/schema.pg.sql:166 |
| TIN `tin` | Tax Identification Number (BIR). Zoho refuses a Sales Order for a business contact with empty `cf_tin`, so the hub stores it and pushes it to Zoho. Re-read from Zoho on every sync with COALESCE (Zoho blank never wipes a local value). | getmeds-backend/src/db/schema.pg.sql:204-213; getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:395-403,484 |
| LTO licence number `lto_license_number` | Stored locally so the duplicate check can answer "that pharmacy is already here"; unique in Zoho (`cf_lto_license_number`). Other licence data (owner, LTO type, issue/expiry dates) is kept only in Zoho and in the pending payload. | getmeds-backend/src/db/schema.pg.sql:168-180 |
| Zoho link | `zoho_contact_id` (partial unique index when not null), `source` (`local`/`zoho`), `last_synced_at`, `is_active` (mirrors Zoho status; only explicit 'inactive' deactivates). | getmeds-backend/src/db/schema.pg.sql:162-165,1218; getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:370-394 |
| Waiting-for-Zoho state | `zoho_sync_status` `synced` (default) / `pending` (created here, not in Zoho) / `failed` (Zoho refused for a reason retrying will not fix); `zoho_pending_payload` (full creation JSON, replayed on push: licence dates, LTO type, both addresses, custom fields); `zoho_sync_error`. | getmeds-backend/src/db/schema.pg.sql:181-203 |
| Open balance `outstanding_receivable` | Synced from Zoho `outstanding_receivable_amount` on every contact sync; shown in the order-form customer dropdown so reps can pick the main account among similarly-named duplicates. Hidden from MedReps/Team Leads in the directory. | getmeds-backend/src/db/schema.pg.sql:214-217; getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:404,485 |
| `credit_limit` | Column exists (default 0, >= 0) but nothing reads or writes it in the app; withheld from sales viewers. | getmeds-backend/src/db/schema.pg.sql:159; getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:17-20 |
| Fields the hub does NOT keep per customer | No payment terms, salesperson, division, price list, tax preference/VAT treatment, credit limit in use, contact-person list, or separate billing/shipping columns. Terms, salesperson, division are per order. | getmeds-backend/src/db/schema.pg.sql:155-219 |

| Limits | Up to 10 documents per customer, 10 MB each; types PDF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, HEIF, Word (.doc/.docx), Excel (.xls/.xlsx). Checked in the browser and again on the server. ### [F1] Soft duplicate check before create (POST /api/customers/check-duplicates)
| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Endpoint and guard | POST /api/customers/check-duplicates — medrep, team_lead, admin, management. Read-only; body uses form names (display_name, contact_number, tin, lto_license_number, email). Answers `{matches}`. The New Customer form calls it on Create; a found match shows a panel instead of creating; a failed check does not stop creation. | getmeds-backend/src/routes/customers.routes.js:28-34; getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:1177-1184; getmeds-frontend/src/components/orders/NewCustomerModal.jsx:418-466 |
| Candidates | Only customers that have a Zoho contact id (never another local-only one), excluding the customer itself when it has an id. | getmeds-backend/src/services/customerCreateService.js:248-260 |
| Name rule | Names compared after lowercase, letters and digits only. `same_name` = identical; `similar_name` = (both >= 6 chars AND the digits in both names are the same AND 1 − editDistance/maxLen >= 0.85) OR every >= 4-letter word of one name (at least 2 words) is inside the other. Different numbers ("Branch 12" / "Branch 13") are never similar. Narrowed first with LIKE on each word's first 4 letters (500 rows). | getmeds-backend/src/services/customerCreateService.js:170-211,262-273 |
| Phone rule | Last 10 digits equal ("+63 917 590 7923" = "0917-590-7923"); ignored when more than 3 Zoho customers share that number (placeholder 09123456789, switchboards). | getmeds-backend/src/services/customerCreateService.js:215-218,275-286 |
| TIN, LTO, email rules | TIN: first 9 digits equal (branch code ignored), TIN >= 9 digits. LTO: exact, case/space-insensitive. Email: exact, case-insensitive. | getmeds-backend/src/services/customerCreateService.js:288-305 |
| Scoring and output | Weights LTO 5, TIN 5, same name 4, email 3, similar name 3, phone 2; top 5 by total. Each match returns id, name, contact person, number, email, TIN, LTO, category, type, address, is_active, zoho id, order count, matched reasons, and `overridable` = false when the reasons include same_name or LTO (the create would be refused anyway, so "create anyway" is not offered), true for softer reasons. | getmeds-backend/src/services/customerCreateService.js:213-229,307-335 |

### [F1] Pending customer actions (server)
| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| GET /api/customers/pending | Admin, management. Every row with status pending/failed (pending first, oldest first) with order_count, `lacking` (from payload; payload itself not sent) and `matches` (findZohoMatches per row); plus counts `pending`, `failed`. | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:825-856; getmeds-backend/src/services/customerCreateService.js:984-995 |
| POST /api/customers/pending/sync (Push all) | Admin, management. A button, never a timer. For each pending row: syncHeldCustomer without overrides. Likely duplicate → `needs_review` (not sent to Zoho); lacking → `needs_review`; Zoho unreachable → stop at once (`blocked`, row stays pending); other refusal → `failed`; success → `synced` with zoho_contact_id. Message e.g. "N customer(s) pushed to Zoho. N refused by Zoho — see "Needs attention" below. N held back — missing details or already looks like a customer in Zoho…", blocked "Zoho still will not accept new customers — the connection is not working yet. Nothing was lost; they stay queued.", nothing "Nothing to push."; `ok` false when blocked, failed or review > 0. | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:858-923 |
| syncHeldCustomer (push one) | Requires status `pending` ("Not a pending customer."). Unless allowed, refuses when findZohoMatches finds anything ("Looks like a customer Zoho already has.") or lacking ("Missing details: …"). Replays the stored payload via zoho.createContact; on success sets zoho_contact_id, status synced, source zoho, clears payload/error, stamps last_synced_at, releases waiting orders. On error: unreachable → stays pending with the error; otherwise → `failed` with the error. | getmeds-backend/src/services/customerCreateService.js:908-981 |
| POST /api/customers/:id/push | Admin, management. Body `{confirm_new: true}` pushes even with matches and missing details. 200 "Created in Zoho as a new customer. N order(s) queued."; 409 LIKELY_DUPLICATE with matches; 503 ZOHO_UNREACHABLE "Zoho still will not accept new customers: … It stays queued."; 404 not pending; 422 other. A `failed` row must first be put back with retry. | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:1101-1125 |
| POST /api/customers/:id/retry | Admin, management. Only a `failed` row (404 "No customer is marked as needing attention with that id."); needs a stored payload (409 NO_PAYLOAD "… Create it directly in Zoho and re-sync customers."); sets status pending, error NULL; "X is queued again." | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:925-971 |
| POST /api/customers/:id/pending-email | Admin, management. Body `{email}`; blank removes it; otherwise must be an email ("Enter a real email address, like name@example.com, or leave it blank to push without one."). Updates row email and the payload email, status pending, error NULL (only while no Zoho id). Log "[CUSTOMER_EMAIL]". No screen calls it (API only). | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:1035-1084 |
| POST /api/customers/:id/link {target_id} | Admin, management. Waiting row must be pending/failed with no Zoho id; target must have a Zoho id (404 otherwise). One transaction: move all orders, delete the waiting row, fill the target's EMPTY fields from the waiting one (contact number, email, TIN, LTO, contact person; category only if NULL) — never overwrite. Audit event per moved order; release moved orders. Message "Now using M, already in Zoho. N order(s) moved to it. The waiting copy was deleted." Nothing created or changed in Zoho. | getmeds-backend/src/services/customerCreateService.js:485-579; getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:1127-1155 |
| POST /api/customers/:id/link {target_id, update} (Update customer) | Admin, management. Validates the form (Name required; Contact Number required; dates yyyy-mm-dd; category in doctor/hospital/distributor/patient). Reads the Zoho contact live (503 "Could not read M from Zoho, so nothing was changed"). Sends to Zoho only fields that differ and are not empty: contact_name (company_name follows when it equalled the old name or was empty), email, phone, billing address (whole object, keeping attention/street2/state/zip/country/phone; shipping follows when it was the same or empty), custom fields contact_number, tin, lto_license_number, lto_type, license_owner, license_issuance_date, license_expiry_date. Zoho refusal → 422/503 "… Nothing was changed — the waiting customer and its orders are as they were." Then links with the form winning over local values (empty keeps). Message "M updated in Zoho (fields)." or "M already had these details in Zoho — nothing needed changing there." | getmeds-backend/src/services/customerZohoUpdateService.js:11-62,202-314; getmeds-backend/src/services/customerCreateService.js:509-537 |
| GET /api/customers/:id/zoho-compare?target_id= | Admin, management. Waiting side = row + payload (name, contact person, contact number, phone, email, TIN, LTO, LTO type, licence owner, issue/expiry, address, city, category); Zoho side = live contact (custom fields by api_name, `_unformatted` first), falling back to the local copy labelled `source: local` with `zoho_error`; order counts both sides; `matched` reasons recomputed on live values. | getmeds-backend/src/services/customerZohoUpdateService.js:67-200; getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:1186-1194 |
| DELETE /api/customers/:id/pending | Admin, management. Waiting row only; refused 409 HAS_ORDERS when orders point at it ("X has N order(s), which would be left without a customer. Use the matching Zoho customer instead — the orders move with it."). Deletes the row (local only). Log "[CUSTOMER_DISCARD]". "X deleted — it will not be pushed to Zoho." | getmeds-backend/src/services/customerCreateService.js:581-605; getmeds-backend/src/controllers/customers.controller.js:1196-1204 |

Descriptive only: nothing in the order flow reads them; whether an account holds a territory is worked out live from user_salespersons | getmeds-backend/src/db/schema.pg.sql:770-855 |
| Zoho salesperson ownership decisions | `salesperson_mappings`: one row per distinct verbatim Zoho salesperson string; `kind` IN ('undecided','person','territory','channel','vacant'), user_id for a person, notes, mapped_by/at. A person decides; later imports self-attribute | getmeds-backend/src/db/schema.pg.sql:918-940,1056-1087 |

### [G] What counts as a sale (two bases)

| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| BOOKED basis (Admin Sales KPIs, Overview, export script) | One row per order in the month (Manila) of its LATEST `FINANCE_VERIFIED` event; excludes imported (ZOHO-) and status cancelled/deleted; amount `orders.total_amount` (with VAT). Same rule as Finance > Sales Summary | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiService.js:167-183; getmeds-backend/scripts/kpi-export-month.js:21-35 |
| INVOICED basis (My KPI, My Team KPI, Team performance; from 9 Nov) | Order counts on its FIRST Zoho invoice date (MIN date) found by its Sales Order numbers (own `zoho_so_number` + `order_split_sales_orders`) in `zoho_invoices.reference_number`; draft/void/deleted invoices excluded; invoiced in Oct and again Nov counts once in Oct; excludes cancelled/deleted/imported; returns invoice numbers and customer | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiService.js:82-113 |
| Net of VAT (line by line) | `SUM(order_items.line_total / (1 + tax_percent/100))` ("No Tax" lines unchanged, discounts already out); an order with no lines falls back to `total_amount` | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiService.js:105, 171-174, 272 |
| Waiting for invoice | Orders with a FINANCE_VERIFIED event since 90 days before the month start, not cancelled/deleted/imported, whose SOs (own or split) have no counted invoice: count and net per owner; shown, never counted ("verified, waiting for invoice — not counted yet") | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiService.js:115-143, 332-353; getmeds-frontend/src/components/dashboard/MyKpiPanel.jsx:126-130 |
| Orders raised | Orders created in the month (Manila), not draft/cancelled/deleted, not imported; per owner | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiService.js:198-203 |
| Orders held | Distinct orders with an event that moved them INTO `on_hold` (old_status ≠ on_hold) in the month; not imported, not deleted; per owner | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiService.js:204-209 |
| Delivered | Booked pesos of orders whose current status is `completed` | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiService.js:273 |
| Zoho Total Sales with Tax | Invoices DATED in the period (status not draft/void, not deleted) minus credit notes dated in the period, both with tax; summed in centavos; Balance Due = unpaid on those invoices; same as Zoho's Sales by Salesperson report | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/adminOverview.controller.js:13-27, 144-182; getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoInvoiceCopy.js:251-294 |

### [G] Scorecard formulas (Hospital CHC playbook, try-out)

| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Counted invoices | `deleted_at IS NULL AND lower(status) NOT IN ('draft','void')` (Overdue and Partially Paid count) | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:42 |
| IST % | invoiced (Zoho total with tax: invoices − credit notes dated 1st..today/month end, credited per person by the Overview rule) ÷ person's kpi_targets target ×100 (1 dp). Running month scored on projection = IST now × days in month ÷ days so far | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:27-34, 207-234, 239-279 |
| IST points | null → 0; >90 → 50; >80 → 40; >70 → 30; >60 → 20; else 0; bonus flag when scored >110; no target → not scored (points null); IST 0 → `caps_month` | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:46, 213-221 |
| IST totals | target and invoiced of people with a target, IST now, projected, people_with_target, at_zero, at_full (50); pace_pct = days so far ÷ days in month; `not_linked_php` (Zoho sales nobody holds) when no prefix | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:223-233, 278 |
| DSO days | open AR ÷ (credit sales this month ÷ days so far), rounded; open AR = balance > 0 on the salesperson's counted invoices of any date; credit sales = invoices dated 1st..today with `due_date > date` (same-day due = cash); days so far = today's day of month; null when no credit sales | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:20-25, 143-175, 281-292 |
| DSO points | null → 0; ≤70 → 20; <90 → 10; else 0; bonus flag when <60 | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:47, 163 |
| DSO ageing and Monday call | Per salesperson: open AR split by invoice age (today − invoice date) 0–30 / 31–60 / 61–90 / 90+, open invoice count, oldest days; rows with nothing omitted; sorted by DSO; `monday_call` = DSO >70, or open AR with no credit sales (DSO null) | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:143-175 |
| DSO only today | Only for the running month and only after the unpaid list has been copied (`open_synced_at`); past month → "DSO shows today's figure only… Past months need the daily snapshot (planned)" | getmeds-backend/src/routes/kpiScorecard.routes.js:34-43 |
| HRR % | customers invoiced last month AND this month (same salesperson) ÷ customers invoiced last month ×100; invoice DATE decides the month; new customers don't change it; salespersons with no last-month customers aren't listed (HRR null in the scorecard) | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:15-18, 104-137 |
| HRR points | 0 if null; ≥95 → 15; ≥85 → 12; ≥75 → 8; else 0 | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:45 |
| HRR lapsed list | Every last-month customer not invoiced yet this month: salesperson, customer, last month sales; sorted by sales desc ("Lapsed accounts to call", the 15th-of-month rescue list) | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:122-136 |
| NZSD % | working days with ≥1 invoice ÷ working days so far ×100; day = invoice CREATION time in Manila (can't be backdated); working days Mon–Fri, no holidays; weekend invoices listed as `weekend_sales_days`, not scored; returns zero_days and sold_days | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:10-13, 54-98, 181-191 |
| NZSD points | ≥95 → 15; ≥90 → 12; ≥80 → 9; ≥70 → 6; else 0 | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:44 |
| Scorecard per PERSON | IST per person; NZSD/HRR/DSO per Zoho salesperson, each salesperson given to the account holding it (`user_salespersons`, primary first); a person's accounts counted together (NZSD a day if any account invoiced, HRR over all customers, DSO over all AR); salespersons nobody holds are left out | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:294-306, 350-388 |
| Total and cap | Total = IST + DSO + HRR + NZSD (null parts 0); IST 0 and sum >40 → total 40 (`capped`); no target → total null (not scored); NZSD missing → 0 points | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:307-334 |
| Max points | 100 with DSO (running month, unpaid copied), else 80 ("scored out of 80") | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:310; getmeds-frontend/src/pages/admin/KpiScorecardPage.jsx:473-477 |
| Verdict | strong ≥ 80% of max; watch > 0; review = 0; not_scored; summary: people, scored, average (rounded), strong, capped, not_scored | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:328-347 |
| Division filter (prefix) | `?prefix=` letters and & only, ≤10 chars; NZSD/HRR/DSO filter `upper(salesperson_name) LIKE 'PREFIX%'`; IST maps prefix to channel: HOS→HOSP, STC→RX · STC, B&B→RX · B&B, URO→RX · URO, B2C→RX · B2C, TELESALES, B2B, BID, CLIDP, MT | getmeds-backend/src/services/kpiScorecardService.js:177-179, 236-237, 276-277; getmeds-backend/src/routes/kpiScorecard.routes.js:32 |
| Coverage guard | Needs the copy to cover the month start (HRR and scorecard: the previous month start); else `available:false` "The invoice copy starts X; this needs Y." | getmeds-backend/src/routes/kpiScorecard.routes.js:44-47 |
| Month validation | `month` YYYY-MM and not in the future (Manila), else 400 "month must look like 2026-10 and not be in the future"; default this month | getmeds-backend/src/routes/kpiScorecard.routes.js:23-31 |

### [H2] Notification model and delivery channels (notificationService)

| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| In-app notification row | notify({ orderId, recipientIds, message, eventType, orderData, payload }) inserts one `notifications` row per non-null recipient: order_id, recipient_id, channel 'in_app', message, payload (JSON, e.g. { deleted_order_id }), sent_at. The eventType is not stored on the row (only used for emails/chat) | getmeds-backend/src/services/notificationService.js:100-115; getmeds-backend/src/db/schema.pg.sql:887-896 |
| Recipients by role | getUserIdsByRole(...roles) = every user with that role and is_active = 1 (no division or team scoping) | getmeds-backend/src/services/notificationService.js:233-242 |
| Internal staff email per notification | For every notify() call an email payload goes to the order's MedRep (orderData.medrep_email, fallback medrep@getmeds.ph): subject "[Getmeds] Order {GM} — {EVENT}", body = message, plus order_id, customer_name, order_total "PHP x,xxx.xx", status, next_action_required, action_link {APP_BASE_URL}/orders/{id}, timestamp, triggered_by (actor name; "System (Auto-Approval)" for ORDER_READY_FOR_DISPATCH on a credit order). next_action text: ready_for_draft_invoice "Awaiting Finance: Confirm Sales Order & Convert to Invoice in Zoho"; ready_for_invoice_sent "Awaiting Finance: Record Customer Payment in Zoho"; ready_for_dispatch "Awaiting Pharmacy: Create Package in Zoho (Picking & Packing)"; picking_packing "Awaiting Pharmacy: Create Shipment in Zoho (Courier & Tracking)"; dispatched "Awaiting Zoho Shipment Confirmation"; on_hold/exception "Action Required: Resolve Order Exception". Always logged as [EMAIL_LOG]; really sent (HTML table) only when SMTP_HOST is set; failures logged, never thrown | getmeds-backend/src/services/notificationService.js:16-72, 117-152 |
| Customer email | For ORDER_SUBMITTED, PAYMENT_VERIFIED, ORDER_DISPATCHED, ORDER_COMPLETED when the order has a customer name: status "Processing" ("Thank you for your order! … being prepared by our pharmacy team."), "Payment Confirmed" ("…confirmed. Your medicines will now be prepared for delivery."), "Dispatched" ("Your order is on the way! Courier: X, Tracking Number: Y." or "packed and handed over to our delivery partner"). Subject "Getmeds Order Update: {GM} — {status}". To customer_email, else a made-up `patient.{name}@gmail.com`. Logged [CUSTOMER_EMAIL_LOG]; sent only with SMTP | getmeds-backend/src/services/notificationService.js:154-186 |
| Google Chat card | Every notify() builds a card (header "Getmeds Order Update", subtitle "Order: {GM}", widgets Event, Order ID, Customer, Status, Triggered By, Message, Timestamp, button "VIEW IN GETMEDS" → {APP_BASE_URL}/orders/{id}); always logged [GOOGLE_CHAT_LOG]; POSTed to GOOGLE_CHAT_WEBHOOK_URL when set (one space for all events); errors logged | getmeds-backend/src/services/notificationService.js:74-98, 188-231 |
| Channel values | notifications.channel CHECK in ('in_app', 'email_log', 'google_chat_log'); only 'in_app' rows are written today | getmeds-backend/src/db/schema.pg.sql:887-896 |

| Purge of old notifications | Read rows older than NOTIFICATION_READ_RETENTION_DAYS (default 30) and unread rows older than NOTIFICATION_UNREAD_RETENTION_DAYS (default 90), by sent_at, deleted in batches of 5,000 until a batch is short. ### [H2] Zoho Sales Order import ("Retrieve Sales Orders" on the Management Dashboard)

| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |

| Start an import | POST /api/orders/import-from-zoho/start?mode=quick\|full (admin, management). Other mode → 400 INVALID_MODE "Query param "mode" must be "quick" or "full"." Returns 202 { job_id, mode } at once and runs in the background; progress: list walk = running count (no total), detail phase = real percentage. Started from the dashboard's Sync menu ("Quick sync: only orders created or changed since the last import", "Full import"); job tracked above the router so leaving the page doesn't abandon it | getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:1088-1158; getmeds-backend/src/routes/orders.routes.js:47-48; getmeds-frontend/src/api/queries.js:240-263 |
| Read-only toward Zoho | Three GETs only: listSalesOrders (paged, 200 per page, onPage progress, sinceWatermark), getSalesOrder (detail: line items, invoices, packages), listSalesOrderComments (Comments & History) | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoOrderImportService.js:36-63, 1100, 954-974 |
| Tier 1: adopt every Sales Order from the list | Full mode: every SO not already known (by zoho_so_id or reference_number = getmeds_order_id) and not void/voided/cancelled/draft_deleted becomes an order: getmeds_order_id `ZOHO-{salesorder_number}` (duplicate numbers in a batch dropped), customer resolved in bulk, medrep_id = system admin, status from Zoho's four axes, customer_type 'direct', total_amount = Zoho total, delivery_address 'See Zoho', sales_order_date, zoho_so_id/number/status, salesperson, delivery_notes "Adopted … Summary only so far", zoho_sync_status 'synced', created_at/submitted_at = Zoho created_time converted to UTC, the four zoho_*_status axes. Batches of 500, ON CONFLICT (getmeds_order_id) DO NOTHING; one ORDER_IMPORTED_FROM_ZOHO each | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoOrderImportService.js:448-579, 112-113 |
| Status from Zoho's four axes | statusFromZoho: status or order_status void/voided/cancelled → cancelled; fulfilled/closed or shipped_status fulfilled → completed; shipped_status shipped/partially_shipped → dispatched; invoiced_status invoiced/partially_invoiced → ready_for_dispatch; draft → so_created; open/confirmed → ready_for_finance_verified; else none | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoStatusMap.js:34-83, 103-111 |
| Bulk status correction (imported orders only) | Full mode: for ZOHO- orders whose status or any axis differs, set status and axes directly (deliberately bypassing the state machine), batches of 500; ZOHO_STATUS_SYNCED for each whose status moved. Orders raised in the app are never touched | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoOrderImportService.js:325-446, 1115-1121 |
| Re-link app orders whose SO id was lost | Before adoption: an order found by reference_number with a blank zoho_so_id gets zoho_so_id, zoho_so_number, zoho_sync_status 'synced' and ZOHO_SO_LINKED; an existing different zoho_so_id is never overwritten | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoOrderImportService.js:893-925, 1259-1294 |
| Tier 2: detail and history within a budget | Full mode picks orders with zoho_detail_synced_at NULL, oldest first, up to ZOHO_SO_IMPORT_MAX (500); quick mode re-reads every SO changed since the watermark. Chunks of 25, ZOHO_SO_IMPORT_CONCURRENCY (3) at once; per order: history first (so real dated entries win), then reconcileOrderFully with the fetched SO, add missing line items and real address, salesperson backfill, stamp zoho_detail_synced_at last. A failed detail fetch is counted (first 20 failures listed); a failed comments fetch keeps the inferred checkpoints | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoOrderImportService.js:65-96, 672-714, 927-999, 1143-1157, 1364-1443 |
| Quick mode watermark | sync_state `salesorders_last_modified_watermark`; first run without it behaves as full. Full runs also save salesorders_last_full_sync_at and salesorders_last_full_total. Quick mode skips status correction, re-linking and tier-1 adoption (new SOs are adopted one by one in tier 2) | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoOrderImportService.js:1095-1098, 1119-1141, 1189-1193 |
| Import summary | mode, total_from_zoho, imported, detailed, awaiting_detail, needs_work, considered, linked, salespersons_backfilled, statuses_corrected, zoho_axes_refreshed, already_present, skipped, log_entries, checkpoints, failed, failures, capped_at, remaining, truncated, stopped_early | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoOrderImportService.js:1159-1187 |
| Enrichment without the list walk | enrichPendingDetail({limit}): the oldest summary-only orders straight from the database (no list call), same detail/history pass; returns counts and awaiting_detail. Driven by scripts/enrich-zoho-history.js and the nightly Windows task | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoOrderImportService.js:1001-1065 |
| Zoho history classified into milestones | Comments & History lines classified: automation chatter (custom function, "the workflow", "could not execute", "reached the maximum limit", "webhook … triggered") and contentless ("Sales Order updated.", "Template has been updated") are skipped and counted; known wordings become milestone events with Zoho's timestamp (date + time at ZOHO_ORG_UTC_OFFSET +08:00) and the Zoho user's name as actor (actor_id NULL); unknown wordings counted and sampled in the log. Idempotent by comment_id (or a date\|time\|text key); metadata zohoCommentId, zohoOperationType, zohoDate, zohoTime, zohoDescription, skipped counts, source, syncedAt, syncedBy 'Zoho history'; entries older than the oldest partition skipped | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoHistoryService.js:1-250; getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoOrderImportService.js:98-211 |

| `ZOHO_DRY_RUN=true` | Strongest tier: no SO create, confirm, invoice, package, shipment, split or split update is sent; fabricated `DRYRUN-` results; order ids prefixed `DryGM-`; the test-customer gate is bypassed. | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoTestFlags.js:1-40; getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoWriteGuard.js:1-35; getmeds-backend/src/services/orderIdService.js:4-16 |

Rules: SO Confirmed (Inventory, Sales Order edited each time, Status is Open → salesorder.confirmed, verified live); SO Cancelled (Status Void → salesorder.cancelled); SO Deleted (Deleted → salesorder.deleted); Package Created (Package created → package.created); Shipment Created (Shipment created or Package status Shipped → shipment.created); Invoice Drafted (Books, Invoice created → invoice.created, verified live); Invoice Sent (Status Sent → invoice.sent); Invoice Paid (Status Paid → invoice.paid); Payment Received (Customer Payment created → payment.created); plus "Sales Order edited" (Edit → salesorder.edited). ### [H1] Retry outbox and its schedules

| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Enqueue | `enqueue({orderId, payload, error, invoicingFrom})` inserts a `zoho_sync_queue` row: status pending, attempts 0, `next_attempt_at` now; `payload` kept only as a record of the first attempt (every retry rebuilds from the DB). Enqueued by order create / approval failures and split failures; manual retry enqueues "Manual retry queued" if no row exists. | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoRetryService.js:42-58; getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js:1247-1259 |
| One retry (`processOne`) | Drops unapproved orders; split rows go to `processSplitRetry`; an order that already has `zoho_so_id` → row marked succeeded (`already_in_zoho`, never a second SO); otherwise rebuild payload (primary lines only), push TIN, `createSalesOrder`, then in one transaction set `orders.zoho_so_id`, `zoho_so_number`, `zoho_sync_status='synced'` and the row `succeeded`; catch up attachments; notify the MedRep. | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoRetryService.js:93-206 |
| Backoff and give-up | Failure: attempts+1; at `MAX_ATTEMPTS` (5) → `failed_permanent`, event, notify management + admin; else `next_attempt_at` = now + min(30 s × 2^attempts, 30 min). Split rows also set `order_split_sales_orders.zoho_sync_status='failed'` and `zoho_sync_error`. | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoRetryService.js:37-40; getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoRetryService.js:207-253; getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoRetryService.js:339-387 |
| Queue pass | `processQueue({force})`: pending rows due (or all pending when forced), oldest first, one at a time. | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoRetryService.js:390-406 |
| Background loop | `start(intervalMs)` every 30 s, only in the running server and only if `ZOHO_AUTO_RETRY_ENABLED=true` (off by default since 30 Aug; manual button instead). | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoRetryService.js:408-425; getmeds-backend/server.js:47-68 |
| Vercel cron | `/api/cron/zoho-retry` daily at 01:30 UTC (09:30 Manila), Bearer `CRON_SECRET` required (refused when unset), runs only when auto retry is enabled, DB lock `zoho_retry` 4 min ("another run holds the lock"). | getmeds-backend/vercel.json:13-16; getmeds-backend/src/controllers/cron.controller.js:145-160 |
| Salesperson refresh | Each auto-sync tick (default every 5 min, `ZOHO_AUTO_SYNC_INTERVAL_MS`; Vercel cron `/api/cron/auto-sync` 01:00 UTC) refreshes the salesperson copy before reconciling orders. | getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoAutoSyncService.js:39-45; getmeds-backend/src/services/zohoAutoSyncService.js:172-186; getmeds-backend/vercel.json:13-16 |

### [H2] Cron lock (database lease)

| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Lease | sync_state row `cron_lock:{name}` whose value is an ISO expiry; acquired by one atomic INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE … WHERE value < now (changes = 1 means held); released by setting the value 1 s in the past (row kept as "last ran"); withLock always releases, including on error; default TTL 5 min, callers use 4 min (under the 300 s function limit). Jobs: auto_sync, zoho_retry, notification_retention, zoho_invoice_copy | getmeds-backend/src/services/cronLock.js:1-87 |

### [I] Tables (schema.pg.sql plus columns migrate.pg.js adds)

Conventions for every table: ids are `INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY` (explicit ids allowed); money and quantities stored as DOUBLE PRECISION (except zoho_invoices/zoho_credit_notes NUMERIC(14,2)); booleans mostly INTEGER 0/1; timestamps TEXT in ISO-8601 with default `iso_now()` (e.g. 2026-09-02T08:00:00.123Z), compared and sorted as strings.

| Format | `<tier>-<YYYYMMDD>-<NNNN>`: tier DryGM (ZOHO_DRY_RUN), TestGM (test customer ids set) or GM; date = the server's UTC date (toISOString), not Manila's; number zero-padded to 4 digits; the id becomes the Zoho Sales Order's reference_number | getmeds-backend/src/services/orderIdService.js:4-17,79-87 (grepped) |
| Atomic per-day counter | `nextSequence(prefixKey)` in its own committed transaction: reads `order_id_sequences.seq` for e.g. 'GM-20260902'; first use of a prefix seeds from the highest existing getmeds_order_id with that prefix (so a restart never reissues 0001); writes seq+1. Numbers are consumed, never reused: a failed order leaves a gap, never a duplicate. Each tier prefix counts on its own | getmeds-backend/src/services/orderIdService.js:18-77 (grepped); getmeds-backend/src/db/schema.sql:132-152 |

### [I] Database layer (pg.js, sqlToPg.js, database.js)

| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| One handle for every query | `database.js` re-exports `pg.js`; `db.init()` must be awaited before the first query (server.js does it before listen and exits with "Could not reach the database… run npm run migrate:pg"); init loads which tables have an `id` and throws "Connected, but no tables found. Apply src/db/schema.pg.sql first." | getmeds-backend/src/db/database.js:1-35; getmeds-backend/src/db/pg.js:382-400; getmeds-backend/server.js:24-35 (grepped) |
| SQLite-style statements translated | Outside quotes/comments/$$ blocks: `?` → $1..$n; LIKE → ILIKE and NOT LIKE → NOT ILIKE (case-insensitive search kept); datetime('now') and strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now') → iso_now(); julianday(col) → EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM col::timestamptz)/86400.0 (used for average processing hours); DATE() in a SELECT list and any leftover SQLite date function are logged once as warnings | getmeds-backend/src/db/sqlToPg.js:1-248; getmeds-backend/src/db/pg.js:91-99 |
| Insert ids and counts | INSERT into a table with an `id` gets RETURNING id so `run()` reports lastInsertRowid; COUNT/bigint parsed to JS numbers (warns above 2^53); PRAGMA table_info(x) answered from information_schema | getmeds-backend/src/db/pg.js:28-65,158-283,364-380; getmeds-backend/src/db/sqlToPg.js:250-260 |
| Transactions | `db.transaction(fn)` checks out one client, BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK, carried through async calls by AsyncLocalStorage so every statement inside runs on it; nested calls join the outer one; after-commit callbacks run only on commit | getmeds-backend/src/db/pg.js:67-83,302-362 |
| Raw escape hatch | `db._rawQuery(sql, params)` runs SQL untranslated (verification harness, rare Postgres-only query) | getmeds-backend/src/db/pg.js:411-422 |

### [I] Migration runner (migrate.pg.js)

| Feature | How it works in the hub (rule, fields, who) | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Run | `node src/db/migrate.pg.js` (npm run migrate:pg) on the direct connection (warns on :6543): applies schema.pg.sql (required, one batch), then schema.pg.trgm.sql (optional), then 46 reconcile steps in a fixed order, then asserts `orders` has at least one index ("orders has no indexes — schema did not apply correctly") and prints table and index counts | getmeds-backend/src/db/migrate.pg.js:1-29,87-96,1513-1604 |
| Widening CHECK lists safely | Finds the CHECK on exactly one column by matching conkey to the column's attnum (never text search; refuses if two constraints cover the column), keeps any extra value still allowed, drops and re-adds in a transaction; used for orders.status, payment_proofs.file_type, users.role, order_events.actor_role, customers.category | getmeds-backend/src/db/migrate.pg.js:98-265,292-362,666-675,997,1104-1111 |

## 19. Every role: screens and actions

### 19.1 Screens by role (router and sidebar)

From `getmeds-frontend/src/App.jsx` (route guards) and `components/layout/Sidebar.jsx` (menus). **M** =
in the role's sidebar; **R** = the route lets the role in but the sidebar does not show it (reached by a
link, the dashboard redirect or the address); blank = refused (sent back to `/dashboard`). The server
checks roles again on every call (see the endpoint rows in sections 1 to 18); with test mode or
`localStorage getmeds_debug_mode=true` the browser opens every route to every role.

Other things every role has in the frame: the top-bar search (orders, customers, products; scoped),
the notification bell with unread count and "mark all read", the post-login stock announcements
pop-up (MedRep and Management), the profile menu (profile, sign out with confirmation).

**What each role does, in one line each** (the detail is in 19.2 and the area sections):

| Role | Raises | Decides | Works | Sees |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MedRep | orders for self or a colleague they cover; customers (held for review when incomplete); refund requests | — | submits, re-submits after send-back or hold, answers holds, uploads proof / Rx / PO, resubmits a prescription, says "stock is back", confirms delivery and completes, cancels a held order with "refund needed?" | own orders (imported Zoho orders read-only), clients directory, own KPIs when switched on, announcements |
| Team Lead | orders for self or their team (and a co-led team) | — | the same as a MedRep for their team | My Team dashboard scoped to their team, Team performance per member, clients directory |
| Management | orders for any rep (approved on creation, except B2B) | approve (warehouse + stock acknowledgement), reject, send back, hold for stock, refund requests, attachment deletions, pending customers | hold / exception / resume at any stage, cancel / restore / delete drafts, relink customer, edit placed orders (pushed to Zoho), order ownership, manager access (full-access managers only) | every order in their divisions (or all), global dashboard, finance's upstream stage, exception hub, refunds owed |
| Finance | — | verify the account and payment (per company half), hold with screenshots, reject a proof, undo within 90 s, reopen | refunds owed and refund-request steps (payment recorded, credit-note check), Zoho steps | finance queue by stage, My Confirmations, reports (sales by salesperson, sales summary), payment history |
| Operation (dispatch, pharmacy) | stock announcements | prescriptions (verify, reject, request, not required, re-review) | cater (claim) orders, confirm for delivery, hold / tracking hold, create invoice, pack, ship with courier and tracking, deliver with proof, return checks (good / damaged), stock pull and adjust | dispatch queue by warehouse, tracking log, pharmacy queue, inventory, return checks |
| Admin | orders, users, structure | user approval, roles, manager access, salesperson mapping | Zoho sync health and retry, KPI targets and visibility switch, team structure import and plans, test mode | everything, KPI pages, scorecard, overview |

## 20. Slice notes and counts

Each slice was read in full by one reader. Its opening notes and its own counts are kept here; the totals at the top remove the overlaps between slices.

### 20.1 Slice A: the orders backend (hub API)

Read in full: `getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js` (4953 lines), `workflowAction.js`, `search.controller.js`, `routes/orders.routes.js`, `routes/search.routes.js`, `workflow/stateMachine.js`, and the services `orderStatusService`, `orderIdService`, `orderOrigin`, `orderSplitService`, `orderClaimService`, `orderCompletionService`, `orderTimelineService`, `orderEventCoverage`, `orderScopeService`, `workflowV2Service`, `workflowFlags`, `paidTermsGuard`, `paymentOnRecord`, `lineAmounts`, `stockHoldService`, `stockCheckService`, `deletedDraftPurge`. Calls outside the slice were grepped only far enough to understand them (auth middleware, teamScopeService, notificationService, auditService, financeHoldService, salespersonService, paymentProof canAttach, dispatch routes, cron controller). All paths below are relative to the hub repo root; `OC` = `getmeds-backend/src/controllers/orders.controller.js`.

**Counts**

**Screens/routes in this slice:** none (backend slice). Screens served: order form pickers, orders list, order page, approval actions, global search dropdown, Zoho import panel.

**Actions (user-pressable things that change data): 31**
create order (draft), create and submit, submit draft, approve, approve with warehouse + stock acknowledgement, reject, send back, mark exception / on hold, resume, re-submit, complete (delivery confirmed), cancel held, cancel draft (discard), cancel draft (keep record), delete draft, restore cancelled draft, stock hold, stock release, edit details, edit items, relink customer, relink to new Zoho customer, sync from Zoho, retry Zoho sync, start Zoho import, create invoice, mark packed, ship, mark delivered, attach file / request attachment removal (counted once), re-submit prescription.

**Endpoints: 44 (43 on the orders router incl. 3 legacy aliases, 1 search), plus the 4 Dispatch routes that run this slice's workflowV2Service**
- GET /api/orders/meta/customers — requireAuth
- GET /api/orders/meta/products — requireAuth
- GET /api/orders/meta/salesperson — requireAuth
- GET /api/orders/meta/medreps — requireAuth (enabled per role inside)
- POST /api/orders/import-from-zoho/start — admin, management
- GET /api/orders/import-from-zoho/status — admin, management
- GET /api/orders — requireAuth (scope inside)
- POST /api/orders — medrep, management, admin, team_lead
- GET /api/orders/:id — requireAuth + order scope
- GET /api/orders/:id/events — requireAuth + order scope
- POST /api/orders/:id/submit — medrep, management, admin, team_lead + no medrep writes on imports
- POST /api/orders/:id/approve — management, admin
- GET /api/orders/:id/stock-check — management, admin
- POST /api/orders/:id/reject — management, admin
- POST /api/orders/:id/send-back — management, admin
- POST /api/orders/:id/resubmit — no medrep writes on imports; role checked inside
- POST /api/orders/:id/complete — no medrep writes on imports; role checked inside
- POST /api/orders/:id/cancel-held — no medrep writes on imports; role checked inside
- POST /api/orders/:id/resubmit-prescription — no medrep writes on imports; role checked inside (pharmacy controller)
- PATCH /api/orders/:id/details — no medrep writes on imports; canEditOrder inside
- POST /api/orders/:id/sync-from-zoho — requireAuth; owner check inside
- POST /api/orders/:id/retry-zoho-sync — no medrep writes on imports; owner check inside
- POST /api/orders/:id/relink-customer — management, admin
- POST /api/orders/:id/relink-customer/new — management, admin
- POST /api/orders/:id/cancel-draft — management, admin
- POST /api/orders/:id/restore-draft — management, admin
- POST /api/orders/:id/stock-hold — management, admin
- POST /api/orders/:id/stock-release — requireAuth; role/owner inside
- GET /api/orders/:id/payment-on-record — management, admin
- POST /api/orders/:id/delete-draft — management, admin
- POST /api/orders/:id/refund — finance, admin
- PATCH /api/orders/:id/exception — management, admin

### 21.3 Hub defects not to copy

Found while reading; listed so the CRM does not carry them over.

| Defect | Hub source |
|---|---|
| Order events endpoint and attachment list have no ownership check: a MedRep can read any order's events and files by id | `controllers/orders.controller.js` (getEvents), `controllers/paymentProof.controller.js` (list) |
| Approve never checks that the approver is not the person who raised the order; reject and send back tell only the rep, not the raiser | `controllers/orders.controller.js` |
| A rep can mark an order completed without it being paid, against the shipped-and-paid rule | `controllers/orders.controller.js` (completeOrder) |
| Customer emails go to a made-up `patient.<name>@gmail.com` address when there is none | `services/notificationService.js` |
| Finance's Undo reports success but never runs its transaction; "bring back for verification" records the actor as System; a held split half can never be verified again | `controllers/finance.controller.js` |
| The queue page sends both attestation ticks on every approve, so the two-tick rule is never enforced | `pages/finance/FinanceQueuePage.jsx` |
| Payment proofs stored in a public Sanity dataset (anyone with the link opens them); refund lists not limited to a scoped manager's divisions | `services/sanityStorage.js`, `controllers/refunds.controller.js` |

#### [H1] H1 — The Zoho adapter and the order-to-Zoho write path

Context: the CRM replaces Zoho, so the retry outbox, write lock, dry run, test-customer gate, OAuth, webhooks and edit-diff are not needed (one database; parity H-039 / H-103 already say so). The gaps below are the business facts the hub carries onto every Sales Order or customer that the CRM order / customer does not yet hold.

| Hub feature | CRM status (No, or Partly: what exists and what is missing) | Hub source | CRM evidence (file, or "none found") |
|---|---|---|---|
